patch.summary: UpLead cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: UpLead pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.title: UpLead plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Essentials
lines.description: 7-day trial · Unlocks: contact data, prospecting, data enrichment · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Plus
lines.description: 7-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Professional
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: UpLead cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price UpLead against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 7-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Credit allowances on Essentials/Plus can limit high-volume list building. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SMB and mid-market teams that need verified B2B contact data with published credit plans requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Credit allowances on Essentials/Plus can limit high-volume list building

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Native email sequencing depth is limited versus dedicated engagement platforms

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not a full CRM system of record

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Professional packaging is contact-sales rather than fully self-serve published dollars

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Lead scoring and AI assistance are limited relative to full SI/engagement suites

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs UpLead on identical constraints.

blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for UpLead alongside category cost modelling.
